e1_development_gate.interpretation: Descriptive development screen only; ten subsampling seeds do not supply ten independent incidents or population significance

e4.interpretation: Empirical development performance only. Neither the split design nor conformal wrapping establishes population, temporal-shift, per-stage or unseen-stage guarantees. Class-conditional95% InitialCompromise uses infinite fallback because calibration n=14.
e4.primary: 90% marginal LAC, TabICL versus the E1 inner-CV-selected GBDT
e4.quantile: ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)) order statistic; infinity if rank exceeds n or class unsupported; no forced singleton

evaluation_scope: Feature-deduplicated within-author-training development split; no incident/temporal/author-holdout generalization claim
execution: Model-subset runs may be combined only with matching input/protocol/class/split/seed/selected-fit fingerprints. Completed immutable cells may be resumed without changing settings; partial cells are preserved as failed attempts. Synthetic smoke fits qualify runtime, not scientific outcomes.
hardware: Prefer existing AWS A10G for foundation inference after sign-in; classical controls may run on CPU. Separate hardware timings cannot support an E2 throughput comparison.
hyperparameter_selection: Three-fold stratified CV macro-F1 within the same 192 selected fitting labels only; deterministic ties choose grid order. No additional labeled validation data.
limitations: Exact feature duplicate removal does not remove all correlated or near-duplicate flows
InitialCompromise has only15 test and14 calibration examples
Balanced training budgets alter class priors
Source stage labels are accepted for this benchmark, not independently human-adjudicated
No early-warning, next-stage forecasting or actor-attribution claim
Broad foundation-model IDS and conformalized foundation IDS already have prior art; novelty remains unestablished
A negative outcome is possible and will be reported
preprocessing: Median imputation fit only on selected fit rows; keep empty columns; repeat inside each inner CV training fold. No test/calibration fitting or selection.
primary_comparator: Best of XGBoost and LightGBM by inner CV for each seed, tie to XGBoost; never select on test
primary_metric: Mean paired test macro-F1 difference over ten common fitting subsamples
title: Few-label APT stage classification and empirical uncertainty
